notes: 2nd generation (NH/NJ/NL, 1991-1999) — the iconic boxy Paris-Dakar era Pajero, best-known 'Pajero/Montero' shape in Brazil (sold as Montero in the Americas and Shogun in the UK). 3.0 V6 wagon, Japanese-spec grey import photographed in Australia. OSX photographer, public domain. 4th-gen alternatives verified: '2019 pajero final edition front.jpg' (2752x1548 CC BY-SA 4.0) and '2007 Mitsubishi Pajero (NS) Exceed wagon 01.jpg' (1737x1179 PD).
